svg.title: Straightedge mark — embroidery, one colour, 50 mm
svg.desc: One thread colour. Two closed shapes, no overlaps, no strokes. 1 user unit = 1 mm. Smallest features at this size: riser 3.0 mm, tread 8.33 mm, kerf 3.25 mm where the straightedge touches each step and 6.5 mm between. Do not run this file smaller than 50 mm — below that use the solid kerf square (straightedge-mark-solid-*.dxf or e3-light-mark-small-1c.svg). See README.md in this folder.
